items.item:
- INV-008: the viewer credential re-issue check: after each re-issue exactly
  one credential is live, the previous one is revoked by the administrator,
  and neither its secret nor a session it opened is accepted; a re-issue
  failing at its audit append leaves every table unchanged
  [witness: verification:viewer_credential_reissue_client_portal].
statements: INV-008: at most one non-revoked ViewerAccessCredential per viewer; re-issue revokes the previous credential atomically

verdicts.why: The check verifies that only the newly issued credential remains live, that the prior credential was revoked by the administrator, and that both its secret and an existing session are rejected. It also repeatedly enforces the one-live-credential limit and injects an audit-append failure, then compares dumps of every table to require complete rollback while confirming the prior live secret and session remain valid.
